supported.paragraph_1: .luma mods, .lumacoop co-op mods, Riivolution packs, disc file replacements, Dolphin texture packs and replacement movies.
supported.paragraph_2: Wii code patches cannot run in a native game, and NebulaCoop lists them at import.
supported.paragraph_3: converts a Wii mod to a .luma or .lumacoop file and lists what it cannot use.

import.paragraph_1: Open Options, then the MODS page. It imports and removes mods.
import.paragraph_2: Choose Import file or Import folder, or drop the mod on the game window. Archives can be .zip, .7z, .rar or .tar, without a password.
import.paragraph_3: When you host, choose the room’s mods on the Host page. When two mods change the same file, the higher one wins.
import.paragraph_4: Choose the mod’s options, then host. Players who join get the room’s mods.

packs.paragraph_1: Dolphin texture packs use tex1_ file names. Texture packs On loads images as needed; Preload loads all of them at startup and uses more memory.
packs.paragraph_2: Replacement movies go in the movies folder, named like the game’s videos (for example PrologueA.mp4), as MP4, MKV or WebM. 4K video needs hardware video decoding.

mod-help.paragraph_1: Turn the mods off on the MODS page (on Windows, you can also hold Shift while NebulaCoop starts). If the problem stops, turn the mods on one at a time. Error codes NEB-M01, NEB-M02 and NEB-M03 name the mod or file involved.

coop.paragraph_1: Mods are the room’s: the host picks them, and joiners download any they don’t have from the host. The mods are checked as each player joins, so everyone plays the same game.
coop.paragraph_2: Co-op mods are packed as .lumacoop. They can see who is in the room, add characters and set players’ colours. Plain Nebula refuses them. NebulaCoop comes with two built-in mods:
coop.item_1: Personal Star Counter, from sm64coopdx: each player’s stars this room and all time. Off by default; the host turns it on.
coop.item_2: Character Movesets: Luigi’s own moves from Super Mario Galaxy. Off by default, so every character plays like Mario.
